summary: This clinical trial is testing different drug treatments for people with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, a condition where the body cannot properly control blood sugar. Researchers want to see how combining two diabetes medications affects blood sugar control and other health measures compared to taking a single drug. The study plans to enroll 90 participants who will take the study treatments and visit the clinic for checkups. This is a Phase 4 study sponsored by University Medical Centre Ljubljana and is currently Recruiting.
